Messages.Author: Satrapa
Messages.Body:


I hate what you did with this storyline. There was only clues (no
statement) that Bahari are Infernalists (they could also be kind of
salvation for the Infernalists according to other clues). So people
often just took what was stronger in this storyline because they
wanted simply to win (so for me in large percentage it was one big set
up).
I hate that you made Kiasyd bunch of totalitarian assholes that punish
other opinions with death (it neither suit scholar bloodline nor
changeling one and they are both and not bunch of UFO drivers).
I'm glad that you did not resurrected dead vampires like you did
earlier with Smiling Jack (It would be shame to read about members of
warrior cast of the Salubri joining Baali).
I like about aftermath 1 thing - how you explained Karsh ADV flaw.

I also hope like Sudden Reversal that it is not the end of this card
game.

If it's the end of VTES, how could the specter exist to tell about it?

Being brought to justice seems for me as as statement of death when
Justicar comes for someone and still we saw Jack Drake in
storylines...
Statement was that Kiasyd are close to changelings and are scholars.
In this storyline they became like bunch of Nazis that burn books that
are not politically correct and kill those that oppose them in their
ranks. Participating in childish, noob satanist, bloody, gore ritual
(lot of killing, reverse reading of Bible) does not sound like neither
changeling style nor scholar style.
Rev. Adams looks for me like mumbling madman and fanatic. Milenium
Cultist was not bunch of good guys so It is at most hard to listen to
Rev Adams. For religious fanatics all who think otherwise are spawns
of hell. What is more M.C. suggested that he was just manipulated
somehow by Nergal and not that he is oracle in any way.

> > (they could also be kind of  salvation for the Infernalists according to other clues).
>
> Indeed. The outcome might depend on who was dominant within the
> faction.

It is not fight for found rising it is sect in more religious way than
Sabbat. What is more agreeing and participating in Baali bloody pit
rituals with lots of sacrifices including vampire sacrifice sounds
also like hard infernal statement.

> >So people often just took what was stronger in this storyline because they
> > wanted simply to win
>
> Nergal might agree with you there.

He might but is it good for the game and for the fluff? I don't think
so.
